paths.name: Path of The Scout
paths.description: A mastery path focused on dealing damage to a single, far-away enemy.

ability.name: Guerilla Training
ability.description: After switching stance your action point costs are reduced by 25% and your movement speed is increased by 20% for 5 seconds.

ability.name: Eye Shot
ability.description: A Crippling shot that deals 141 damage,  reduces your target's Initiative by 150 for 10 seconds. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

ability.name: Enchanted Arrows
ability.description: Flame Arrow and Festering Arrow will now bypass all of your victim's resistances.

ability.name: Festering Arrow
ability.description: Deals 1033 Corporeal damage to your target.

ability.name: No Quarter
ability.description: Eagle's Eye and Festering Arrow now builds up 1 seconds faster.

ability.name: Fell The Weak
ability.description: Deals 928 damage if your target is below 30% hit points, or 366 damage otherwise.

ability.name: Rain of Steel
ability.description: You repeatedly shoot arrows at the ground for 10 seconds, dealing 219 damage every second to all enemies within 20 feet of that spot.

coreAbilities.name: Eagle Eye
coreAbilities.description: A well aimed arrow that deals 487 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Acid Arrow
coreAbilities.description: An attack which deals 328 damage and reduces your target's armor by 990 and reduces their chance to block by 10% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Rapid Fire
coreAbilities.description:
You move with blinding speed as you quickly fire several shots at your target, dealing 134 damage to the enemy twice per second for up to 3 seconds.  This effect will end if you break your concentration, or run out of action points.
If you are Vengeful, then the shots will deal 10% more damage.

coreAbilities.name: Glass Arrow
coreAbilities.description: Deals 265 damage to your target and reduces range on their abilities to 75% for the next 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Throat Shot
coreAbilities.description: A Crippling shot that deals 366 damage and silences your target for 4 seconds, making them unable to use magic.

paths.name: Path of Assault
paths.description: A mastery path focused on fighting in melee combat.

ability.name: Sinister Assault
ability.description: Brutal Assault will now bypass all of the target's armor.

ability.name: Shadowstep
ability.note:
Requires Assault Stance
You cannot perform this action while rooted
You cannot perform this action while airborne
ability.description: You merge with the shadows and appear on your target within the blink of an eye. For the next 10 seconds your defences will be increased by 15%. Cant be used if there is a too big height difference between you and your target or if you are airborne.

ability.name: No Respite
ability.description:
Your damage is increased by 15% when under 45 feet away from your target.
Does not affect damage procs.

ability.name: Crosscut
ability.description:
You unleash two swift blows upon your enemy that deal 164 damage each, causing them to be 10% more likely to be critically hit by others for 10 seconds.
If you are Vengeful, then this attack deals spirit damage instead.

ability.name: Merciless Soldier
ability.description: Increases the critical damage of your direct damage Path of Assault abilities by 50% and the critical chance of Swift Strikes and Draw Blood by 25%.

ability.name: Exploit Weakness
ability.description: A Crippling attack which deals 352 damage and knocks down your target for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Whirling Rage
ability.description: Deals 2400 damage to all enemies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Grim Slash
coreAbilities.description: Deals 277 damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Brutal Assault
coreAbilities.note:
Target must be facing away from you
Requires Assault Stance
coreAbilities.description:
Deals 427 damage to your target, and makes monsters hate you less than normal.  Only usable when you are behind the target.
If you are Vengeful, then this attack may be used from any position.

coreAbilities.name: Draw Blood
coreAbilities.description: An Ailment which deals 651 damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Swift Strikes
coreAbilities.description:
You unleash a punishing series of attacks on your enemy for up to 3 seconds, striking them twice per second and dealing 110 damage per hit.  If the target is building up an ability, then your strikes will deal 204 damage instead.  This ability will end if you break your concentration or run out of action points.
If you are Vengeful, then duration is increased to 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Opportunistic Strike
coreAbilities.description: A Crippling attack that deals 277 damage and disarms your target for 4 seconds, making them unable to use melee or ranged weapons.

coreAbilities.name: Sweeping Slash
coreAbilities.description: Deals 296 damage to all enemies in an arc in front of you, up to 25 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Counterstrike
coreAbilities.description: A quick strike which deals 164 damage to your target and interrupts any ability that they were building up.

paths.name: Path of The Skirmisher
paths.description: A mastery path focused on fighting multiple enemies at medium range.

ability.name: Split Arrows
ability.description: Spiral-Fletched Arrow and Broadhead Arrows now hit all enemies within 20 feet of your initial target, but their range is reduced to 65ft and they do 20% less damage.

ability.name: Flame Arrow
ability.description:
An Ailment which deals 231 Elemental damage to your target and then explodes, dealing an additional 369 Elemental damage over 9 seconds to the target and all other enemies within 20 feet of them.
If you are Vengeful, the radius is increased by 10 feet.

ability.name: Keen Arrowheads
ability.description: Increases the durations of Broadhead Arrows to 21 seconds, Takedown to 15 seconds, and Flame Arrow to 15 seconds.

ability.name: Shadow Sting
ability.description: An Ailment which deals 681 damage to your target over 9 seconds and causes all healing effects used on them to become 50% weaker.  Only usable on a target that is already Ailing.

ability.name: Powerful Draw
ability.description: Increases the armor penetration of all Path Of The Skirmisher attacks by 15%.

ability.name: Barrage
ability.description:
Deals 390 damage to all enemies in an arc in front of you, up to 40 feet away.
If you are Vengeful, this attack removes 100 points of morale from the enemy.

ability.name: Penetrating Arrow
ability.description: Deals 1200 damage to all enemies in front of you, up to 40 feet away, and an additional 1200 damage over 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Broadhead Arrow
coreAbilities.description: An Ailment which deals 1040 damage to your target over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Takedown
coreAbilities.description:
An Ailment which deals 291 damage and snares your target, reducing their run speed by 40% for 8 seconds. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.
If you are Vengeful, then the target will also be knocked down for 2 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Spiral-Fletched Arrow
coreAbilities.description: Deals 291 damage to your target. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Flanking Shot
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Skirmish Stance
Target must be facing away from you
coreAbilities.description: Deals 441 damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Lileath's Arrow
coreAbilities.description: A piercing arrow which deals 401 damage to all enemies in front of you, up to 65 feet away.  This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Bolster War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted buff. Increases damage done by that siege engine by 2% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hamper War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Increases the cooldown times of that siege engine by 50% for 10 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Diminish War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Decreases damage done by that siege engine to 98% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Scout Stance
coreAbilities.description:
A long-distance bow stance that increases your Ballistic Skill and Initiative by 100 and the range of your bow attacks by 10%.

You may only use a single Stance at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Assault Stance
coreAbilities.description:
A close-combat stance which increases your Strength and Weapon Skill by 100, and increases your Armor by the same amount that you receive from items.

While in Assault Stance your ranged prowess item stats will count towards your melee prowess in a 1 to 1 conversion respectively. Parry chance is increased by 10%, Auto Attack speed is increased by 35%.

You may only use a single Stance at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Skirmish Stance
coreAbilities.description:
A close-range bow stance that increases your Toughness by 100 and the chance that your bow attacks will critically hit by 5%. You gain the ability to autoattack while moving while in this stance.

You may only use a single Stance at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Distracting Shot
coreAbilities.description: You Detaunt your target, making them hate you less and causing them to deal only 50% damage to you for 15 seconds. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone that you have Detaunted, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Hunter's Fervor
coreAbilities.description: An inspired ferver fills your group, giving 5 Action Points every second for 15 seconds to all groupmates within 100 feet of you.

coreAbilities.name: Point-Blank
coreAbilities.description: A mid-range attack that deals 600 damage and knocks the targeted player away. Monsters will be knocked down.

coreAbilities.name: Centuries of Training
coreAbilities.description: Upon striking a target with direct damage there is a 25% chance to inflict an additional 303 Spirit damage over 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Whirling Pin
coreAbilities.note: You cannot perform this action while airborne
coreAbilities.description: All enemies within 25 feet become snared, reducing movement speed by 30% for the next 5 seconds. You are knocked back away from your enemies.

coreAbilities.name: Vengeance of Nagarythe
coreAbilities.description:
You are filled with a desire for vengeance, increasing all damage you deal by 25% for 10 seconds. During this time some of your abilities will gain additional effects.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Expert Skirmisher
coreAbilities.description: Your cast times are reduced to 50% when you are within 20 feet of your target.

coreAbilities.name: Replenishing Strikes
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy, you will regain 40 Action Points. Tactic can not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Masterful Aim
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Ballistic Skill by 160

coreAbilities.name: Concealment
coreAbilities.description: With luck and experience you are able to Dodge all ranged attacks and Disrupt all magic attacks against you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bend the Winds
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Elemental resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Steady Aim
coreAbilities.description: While this ability is active, your ranged abilities will inflict 25% more critical damage but will cost an additional 25% action points.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Mind
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, you will remove and ignore any rooting, snaring, disarming, silencing or disabling effects. Your cast times are reduced by 50%, and you cannot be set back.

coreAbilities.name: Wrist Slash
coreAbilities.description: Grim Slash will now reduce your enemy's Weaponskill by 150 and Initiative by 150 for 20 seconds, and increase your Weaponskill and Initiative by the same amount.

coreAbilities.name: Discerning Offense
coreAbilities.description: Your attacks have a 10% reduced chance to be defended against.

coreAbilities.name: Explosive Shots
coreAbilities.description:
All of your ranged attacks will explode for the next 10 seconds, dealing 300 damage to all enemies within 20 feet of your target.
This effect will not trigger more than once every second.

coreAbilities.name: Clever Recovery
coreAbilities.description:
If an enemy dodges any of your attacks, you will regain 75 Action Points.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Smoldering Arrows
coreAbilities.description: Flame Arrow's damage over time is increased to 672 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Lileath's Forgiveness
coreAbilities.description: Removes all Hexes, Curses, Cripples, and Ailments from you.  You regain 250 Action Points.

coreAbilities.name: Pierce Defenses
coreAbilities.description: If an enemy blocks, dodges, or parries any of your attacks, their chances to dodge and parry will be reduced by 10% and their ability to block reduced by 5% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Distracting Rebounds
coreAbilities.description: Distracting Shot will now also affect any other enemies within 20 feet of your initial target.

coreAbilities.name: Ambush
coreAbilities.description: Hidden Allies come to your aid and launch an attack that deals 900 over 3 seconds to all enemies within 20 feet, and snares the targets by 60%.

coreAbilities.name: Instinctive Aim
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength, Ballistic Skill, and Weapon Skill by 120, but reduces your Toughness by 120.

coreAbilities.name: Bullseye
coreAbilities.description: Whenever you critically hit an enemy, your chance to critically hit is increased by 20% for 5 seconds, but you also become 10% more vulnerable to being critically hit.

coreAbilities.name: Instill Fear
coreAbilities.description: You deal 1200 damage to all enemies within 25 feet and staggers the target for up to 6 seconds, preventing all actions unless they are damaged.

coreAbilities.name: Leading Shots
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit with a ranged attack, the chance to critically hit will be increased by 8% for 10 seconds for group members within 100 feet, but this will not affect you.

coreAbilities.name: Blood-Soaked War
coreAbilities.description: Any time you kill an enemy, you will instantly regain 321 health.

coreAbilities.name: Hail of Doom
coreAbilities.description: You focus on a spot on the ground, shooting arrows at that spot every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds, hitting all enemies within 20 feet of that area for 300 damage as long as you maintain your concentration.
